title: Computation of the Outpatient Surgery Pre-Service Balance (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
**§1 Scope.** For the pre-service balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery estimate under Good Faith & Price Estimates this computation settles the amount, and only for such a balance. The pre-delivery balance on a maternity and delivery package is not figured by it, and on every other package type with balance-due days above zero the rest of the package price is paid no later than that many calendar days before the scheduled service date as a pre-service balance deposit.

**§2 No balance owed.** A surgery booking whose patient's award covers the scheduled service date and either is at the Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care or Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) tier, or carries a hardship liability cap with no cap left, and a booking whose balance figure comes to zero or less, owe no pre-service balance and are outside this computation. The patient's award is the patient's approved case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; it covers the scheduled service date when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.

**§3 The balance.** The pre-service balance on a self-pay outpatient surgery package is the rest of the surgical package price: that price less the deposits held on the estimate, rounded half-up to the cent. The surgical package price is the sum of the Riverbend facility line and the Riverbend professional line that carry the principal service code on the current version, and the deposits held are the deposit collections on the estimate less every refund, retained fee and application drawn on them.

**§4 Figuring the balance.** A figure that takes the place of the surgical package price does so before the deposits held are taken off; every amount added to or taken off the balance is figured on its own and added to or taken from that rest; and the total is rounded half-up to the cent once at the end (an exact half cent going up).

**§5 When the balance is fixed.** The pre-service balance is fixed only after the booking carries its initial deposit collection. The pre-service balance is not fixed until the booking shows a retained late-change fee entry for its late patient move, where it has one; a booking carries at most one such entry. A late patient move of a surgery booking is a cancellation of its procedure slot, the first patient-cancelled Outpatient Procedure Appointment the appointment record lists, made on or before the slot date and fewer calendar days before it than the type's full-refund days, while the estimate is not cancelled and its current version, a later version furnished on or after the cancellation date, carries a scheduled service date different from the slot date, with no Riverbend inpatient room charge (revenue code 0120) or observation charge (revenue code 0762) dated on the cancellation date, such a charge counting only when the hospital account it is posted on, for each of the two codes the account of the first such line the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account activity lists for that date, carries charges net of the charge credits recorded on that account above zero, so that a credited line on an account that still carries net charges still counts.

In record terms: while the deposit activity shows no initial deposit collection, the balance is not yet fixed; and where the records show a late patient move of the booking, the balance is not yet fixed while the deposit activity shows no retained late-change fee entry.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Riverbend facility line 3000.00 and Riverbend professional line 1000.00 for the principal code: surgical package price 4000.00. Deposit collections 2100.00 with a refund of 100.00 drawn on them: deposits held 2000.00. Pre-service balance: 4000.00 less 2000.00, that is 2000.00. Had the deposits held been 4000.00 or more, the figure would be zero or less and no pre-service balance would be owed.
